glosses: divorce (the legal dissolution of a marriage)

examples.en: I thought you wanted a divorce.

examples.text: El divorcio se está popularizando últimamente.
examples.en: Divorce is becoming more common nowadays.

examples.text: Tom y Mary tuvieron un divorcio desagradable.
examples.en: Tom and Mary had an ugly divorce.

examples.text: Las noticias sobre su divorcio fueron una gran sorpresa.
examples.en: The news that she got divorced was a big surprise.
